assumptions: Conditional parallel trends in untreated potential outcomes
No effects earlier than the two-year anticipation allowance
Verified first qualifying operational opening and prior-exposure histories
Adequate common support for each treated cohort and comparison set
Comparable outcome definitions and geographic boundaries

audit.comparison_policy: Never treated or not yet treated and outside their anticipation window; absence from a short project list does not establish untreated status
audit.covariate_policy: All baseline covariates constant within municipality and measured at one common year no later than the earliest eligible opening minus three; comparisons share that covariate vintage. Outcome changes use each cohort's clean base year.
audit.overlap_failure_policy: Block the affected comparison; never silently clip propensity scores or trim the estimand
audit.placebo_policy: Report clean pretreatment pseudo-effects and joint test, false timing within clean pretreatment, and neighboring-municipality exclusions when a verified adjacency file exists
audit.pretrend_policy: Passing a pretrend test does not prove parallel trends; failures block a causal-results label and remain visible

dag.unblocked_risk: Unobserved time-varying local prospects or policy packages can violate conditional parallel trends. Observed covariates cannot prove this path absent.

causal_design.estimand: ATT(g,t) of the first verified qualifying foreign-invested operational opening; average over event years 1–5

implementation.data_access: pySidraData commit 85a2b39c0cc5eec56d0a3605bbfa1d497899cc8e plus versioned official BCB/IBGE/RAIS sources
implementation.legacy_boundary: The immutable national archive retains its original specification. This separately hashed Python design supersedes its unexecuted municipal R implementation.

causal_design.national_boundary: The completed SVAR and identified-shock local projections remain conditional on their frozen recursive restrictions. The handbook is not presented as independent validation of those restrictions.
causal_design.population: Eligible municipalities with verified treatment histories and comparable annual outcomes; not all FDI dollars

references.application: Explicit confounding paths and prohibition of post-treatment controls
references.title: Matheus Facure — Graphical Causal Models

references.application: Separate treatment and outcome nuisance models; overlap required; no immunity to unobserved confounding
references.title: Matheus Facure — Doubly Robust Estimation

references.application: Cohort-time effects and eligible controls; avoid already-treated comparisons and naive constant-effect TWFE
references.title: Matheus Facure — The Difference-in-Differences Saga

references.application: Python group-time DR estimator, municipality multiplier bootstrap and simultaneous event-study bands
references.title: ModernDiD Python att_gt

references.application: Pinned IBGE SIDRA metadata and observations; source definitions and raw response hashes preserved
references.title: Fernando Barbosa — pySidraData

robustness: Cohort and sector estimates only where support passes
causal_design.role: Primary municipal counterfactual impact design; separate from national SVAR dynamics

assumptions: Conditional parallel trends in untreated potential outcomes
No effects earlier than the two-year anticipation allowance
Verified first qualifying operational opening and prior-exposure histories
Adequate common support for each treated cohort and comparison set
Comparable outcome definitions and geographic boundaries

audit.comparison_policy: Never treated or not yet treated and outside their anticipation window; absence from a short project list does not establish untreated status
audit.covariate_policy: All baseline covariates constant within municipality and measured at one common year no later than the earliest eligible opening minus three; comparisons share that covariate vintage. Outcome changes use each cohort's clean base year.
audit.overlap_failure_policy: Block the affected comparison; never silently clip propensity scores or trim the estimand
audit.placebo_policy: Report clean pretreatment pseudo-effects and joint test, false timing within clean pretreatment, and neighboring-municipality exclusions when a verified adjacency file exists
audit.pretrend_policy: Passing a pretrend test does not prove parallel trends; failures block a causal-results label and remain visible

dag.unblocked_risk: Unobserved time-varying local prospects or policy packages can violate conditional parallel trends. Observed covariates cannot prove this path absent.

design.estimand: ATT(g,t) of the first verified qualifying foreign-invested operational opening; average over event years 1–5

implementation.data_access: pySidraData commit 85a2b39c0cc5eec56d0a3605bbfa1d497899cc8e plus versioned official BCB/IBGE/RAIS sources
implementation.legacy_boundary: The immutable national archive retains its original specification. This separately hashed Python design supersedes its unexecuted municipal R implementation.

design.national_boundary: The completed SVAR and identified-shock local projections remain conditional on their frozen recursive restrictions. The handbook is not presented as independent validation of those restrictions.
design.population: Eligible municipalities with verified treatment histories and comparable annual outcomes; not all FDI dollars

references.application: Explicit confounding paths and prohibition of post-treatment controls
references.title: Matheus Facure — Graphical Causal Models

references.application: Separate treatment and outcome nuisance models; overlap required; no immunity to unobserved confounding
references.title: Matheus Facure — Doubly Robust Estimation

references.application: Cohort-time effects and eligible controls; avoid already-treated comparisons and naive constant-effect TWFE
references.title: Matheus Facure — The Difference-in-Differences Saga

references.application: Python group-time DR estimator, municipality multiplier bootstrap and simultaneous event-study bands
references.title: ModernDiD Python att_gt

references.application: Pinned IBGE SIDRA metadata and observations; source definitions and raw response hashes preserved
references.title: Fernando Barbosa — pySidraData

robustness: Cohort and sector estimates only where support passes
design.role: Primary municipal counterfactual impact design; separate from national SVAR dynamics

identification_audit.bcb_boundary: Individual foreign-capital census records are confidential; published aggregates cannot classify untreated municipalities.

municipal.reason: Verified operational-opening and prior-exposure histories, defensible comparison municipalities and the harmonized IBGE/RAIS outcome panel are not yet available. No local causal effect is estimated.

municipal_coverage.note: GDP/GVA reference-2010 series 2002–2023; revised GDP per capita has its own coverage. Sector gaps are not filled.

national.boundary: Estimated structural responses conditional on the declared restrictions. Failed diagnostics prevent a causal-results release.
controls: Change in effective federal funds rate

diagnostics.boundary: Economic identification assumptions remain untestable; diagnostics are necessary checks, not proof of causality.

whiteness.method: adjusted multivariate portmanteau; restriction-adjusted asymptotic degrees of freedom

national.identification: Recursive Cholesky in declared variable order; Brazil lags excluded from NFCI equation; correlated residual vectors preserve contemporaneous covariance.

local_projections.boundary: Same identified shocks, not independent causal evidence

derived_fields: FEVD: h-step forecast horizon uses Psi_0 through Psi_(h-1); native archive summary retained unchanged
Historical initial-condition and deterministic components separated without refitting

sensitivity.name: Order: nfci, gdp_growth, fdi_gdp, gfcf_growth, reer_change
Order: nfci, gdp_growth, gfcf_growth, fdi_gdp, reer_change

population_extension.gaps: Unpublished census/estimate years remain missing. No interpolation or foreign-capital allocation.
population_extension.kind: official observed population, not FDI or a causal estimate

study.author: Fernando Barbosa

historical_research.title: Determinantes do Investimento Estrangeiro Direto no Brasil no período de 1995 a 2010

study.identification: Recursive Cholesky in declared variable order; Brazil lags excluded from NFCI equation; correlated residual vectors preserve contemporaneous covariance.
study.lag_criterion: BIC on a common maximum-lag sample
measurement_rules: Never combine BPM5 and BPM6 silently
Negative and suppressed values are not zero
Country-sector cells require a published joint distribution
Municipal context and project locations are not measured municipal FDI
Source vintages and boundary years are explicit
Quarterly FDI USD converted monthly at the period-average BRL/USD rate and divided by quarterly nominal BRL GDP; conversion is part of the estimand
Reer direction must follow the selected source definition
No causal claim if diagnostics or identification gates fail

local_projections.boundary: inherits structural identification; not independent causal evidence
local_projections.identified_shocks: same fitted structural shocks as SVAR

municipal_did.estimator: Python ModernDiD 0.4.0 / Callaway–Sant’Anna doubly robust ATT(g,t)
gates: five clean pre-periods and five post-periods
no personal microdata in public export
municipal_did.inference: municipality-clustered multiplier bootstrap; simultaneous confidence bands
municipal_did.treatment: first verified operational foreign-invested establishment opening, not announcement

svar.inference: residual-vector bootstrap, fixed selected lag and exogenous path, refit restricted system and re-identify every replication
svar.stationarity_gate: ADF p>0.10 and KPSS p<0.05 blocks a level input; no automatic silent re-specification

study.municipal_language: Python only; separately versioned causal extension
study.release_policy: Article draft and local preview only; no public publication or scheduling
study.title: Brazil FDI Observatory

validation.boundary: Validation checks numeric/source integrity, not economic causal identification.
